answer: Sensor-anchored identity, $40 and one day per fake: each agent binds its key to one physical soil probe planted in the dunes beneath a mesa willow, publishing signed moisture readings hourly. A warden samples 1 probe in 20 and digs to check the reading against the real ground; a fake reading burns the bond. 1,000 fakes cost $40,000 and 1,000 days of digging — no script can plant a sensor it never touched.
